messages:
AcmeApps-support: Hi team, urgent: our reranking UI exploded after your deploy. We relied on the API to return probabilities but now some scores are negative and one is >1. Screenshot attached. Can you advise?

maria (CS): Sorry to hear this — can you paste the exact request + response you sent? Well triage.

AcmeApps-support: Sending sanitized payload and response. Request:
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "best coffee shops in seattle",
  "candidates": ["CafeX", "RoastHouse", "BeanScene"],
  "model": "rerank-v2",
  "top_k": 3
}
```
Response from our call:
```
{ "scores": [ -1.2, 0.45, 1.7 ], "order": [2,1,0] }
```

maria (CS): Thanks. Were looking now. @dylan can you confirm semantics for rerank-v2?

dylan (eng): On it. Quick answer: rerank-v2 returns raw scores (logits) by design. Theyare not normalized probabilities and can be negative or >1. We changed the head in the last release to avoid implicit normalization interfering with calibration experiments.

AcmeApps-support: Thats unfortunate as our frontend assumes sum(scores) == 1. It displayed negative percent and 170% for one result. Customer says the change was unexpected.

priya (ml): Added context: logits are fine for ranking and for many metrics (AUC, NDCG). We intentionally output logits because softmaxing server-side for huge candidate lists caused numeric issues and masked model calibration problems.

maria (CS): The customer needs either a server-side normalized output or a quick patch they can apply client-side while we decide. ETA?

lee (release): Propose options: 1) Add optional query param normalize=true to return softmaxed probabilities. 2) Update docs and ship SDK helper function only. 3) Revert to old behavior (not ideal). I can do 1) as a hotfix behind a feature flag. If accepted, Ill spin up a branch.

dylan (eng): Implementing normalize=true is small: compute stable softmax over the returned scores and return in the same field (or a new field). Need to be careful with candidate limit codepaths. I can push a hotfix.

maria (CS): Meanwhile please provide a client-side snippet we can paste to the customer for immediate mitigation. Keep it simple and numerically stable.

priya (ml): Draft snippet (numeric-stable softmax):
```
# python stable softmax
import math

def stable_softmax(scores):
    m = max(scores)
    exps = [math.exp(s - m) for s in scores]
    s = sum(exps)
    return [e/s for e in exps]

# example
scores = [-1.2, 0.45, 1.7]
probs = stable_softmax(scores)
# -> ~ [0.028, 0.151, 0.821]
```

maria (CS): Perfect. Ill send that immediately and note were working on a server-side flag. Also including an explanation they can paste: "The rerank endpoint returns raw logits in rerank-v2; logits are unbounded and intended for ordering. To get probabilities apply softmax. We are adding an optional server-side normalization param for convenience."

dylan (eng): Branch created: feature/rerank-normalize. Adding ?normalize=true behavior and SDK response helper. Will run tests.

deploy-bot: CI started for feature/rerank-normalize (rerank-service). 8 tests failed initially, investigating logs.

dylan (eng): Those failures were flakiness in candidate-limit tests; re-ran CI.

deploy-bot: CI passed. Staging deploy queued.

dylan (eng): Deployed to staging. Smoke test: POST /v1/rerank?normalize=true returns:
```
{ "scores": [0.028, 0.151, 0.821], "order": [2,1,0] }
```
Works as expected.

lee (release): Canary rollout starting (5% traffic) with normalize flag. Monitoring latency and error rates.

release-bot: Canary health OK after 10m. No error spike.

maria (CS): Customer applied client patch and thanked us. Theyd like server-side normalize enabled asap so they can remove emergency patch. Theyre on Enterprise SLA.

dylan (eng): Rolling normalize=true to prod now. Also added response metadata: when normalize=true we set response.normalized = true and include raw_scores in debug mode (off by default) to avoid breaking clients that depend on previous shape.

deploy-bot: Prod rollout complete. No regressions.

AcmeApps-support: Confirmed fixed. They removed emergency client patch and reported UI looks correct now. :thumbsup:

maria (CS): Closing incident after 48h monitoring unless customer reopens.

priya (ml): Postmortem notes for engineering: 1) Release changed semantics (rerank-v2) without explicit migration docs. 2) Add a CI smoke that checks for output range changes for endpoints that historically returned probabilities. 3) Add API compatibility policy and deprecation window for semantics changes.

lee (release): Also adding SDK convenience functions (response.toProbabilities()) and updating docs top of rerank page with clear language: "rerank returns logits by default; use normalize=true or apply softmax client-side for probabilities."

maria (CS): Action item: update customer-facing KB with example snippets for JS/Python and a short note on when to prefer logits vs probabilities.

AcmeApps-support: Thanks again for the fast turnaround. We appreciate the flag and the explanation.
